top_news.title: 65 Vietnamese Leaders and Enterprises Honored at Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards 2026 for Forging Legacies of Excellence
top_news.summary: HO CHI MINH CITY, Vietnam, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 65 distinguished leaders and enterprises were honored for their outstanding achievements, entrepreneurial spirit, and enduring contributions at the Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards (APEA) 2026 Vietnam, held at GEM Center, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Organized by Enterprise Asia, the prestigious awards recognized entrepreneurs and organizations that have demonstrated excellence in leadership, business performance, innovation, and responsible growth, while making meaningful contributions to Vietnam's evolving business landscape. 65 Vietnamese Leaders and Enterprises Honored at Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards 2026 for Forging Legacies of Excellence Held under the theme "Forging Legacy: Celebrating Excellence, Inspiring Tomorrow", the Awards celebrated the achievements of leaders and enterprises that are building beyond the present to create lasting value for the future. This year's honorees demonstrated the vision, resilience, and adaptability needed to navigate a rapidly changing business environment, while remaining committed to innovation, responsible business practices, and long-term growth. More than 350 nominations from across Vietnam underwent a rigorous judging process conducted by a distinguished panel of experts. Nominees were evaluated based on leadership excellence, business performance, innovation, sustainability, governance, and overall impact. Following extensive deliberations, outstanding winners were selected across five award categories: Master Entrepreneur, Inspirational Brand, Fast Enterprise, Corporate Excellence, and the Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award. The newly introduced Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award recognizes organizations that demonstrate exemplary governance, ethical leadership, transparency, accountability, and effective risk management. Since 2007, the APEA has been organized across Asia to recognize exceptional business leaders and enterprises that have made significant contributions to entrepreneurship and economic development. Over the years, the Awards have recognized prominent business figures including Mr. Kwek Leng Beng of Hong Leong Group Singapore, Indonesia's Hary Tanoesoedibjo of MNC Group, the Philippines' Manuel Villar of Vista Land, and Vietnam's Dang Van Thanh of TTC Group. In his welcome address, Enterprise Asia Chairman Dr. Fong Chan Onn highlighted the importance of forward-looking leadership in driving sustainable growth and lasting impact. "Today's business landscape is evolving at an unprecedented pace. Enterprises must look beyond responding to change, harness innovation, strengthen collaboration, and embrace new opportunities. By leading with purpose and vision, businesses can achieve sustainable growth while creating lasting value for their stakeholders and communities." The distinguished awardees of the APEA 2026 Vietnam reflect the diversity, ambition, and entrepreneurial strength of Vietnam's business community. The Master Entrepreneur category recognized visionary leaders such as Mr. Ly Anh Duy Quang, BOD Member of GREENFEED Vietnam Corporation; Mr. Mai The Toan, Chairman of The Board of Directors of Petrovietnam Drilling & Well Service Corporation (PV Drilling), for their visionary leadership, entrepreneurial excellence, and ability to build businesses with lasting value. Under the Inspirational Brand category, industry leaders such as BaoViet Life Corporation, Bia Saigon, and 333 were honored for their strong brand presence, market influence, and meaningful engagement with customers and stakeholders. Fast-growing enterprises including Saigon International General Hospital (SIG) received the Fast Enterprise award for their impressive growth, agility, and ability to respond effectively to emerging opportunities. Meanwhile, established organizations such as Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB BANK) and Masterise Group were recognized under the Corporate Excellence category for their sustained business performance, organizational strength, and contributions to their respective industries. The Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award further recognized organizations including Saigon Bank For Industry And Trade (SAIGONBANK) and Kafi Securities Corporation for their commitment to ethical leadership, sound governance, transparency, and responsible corporate practices. The APEA 2026 Vietnam Chapter is supported by Snowball Consulting as its Official Implementation Partner, with PR Newswire serving as the Official News Release Distribution Partner and COCOON as the Door Gift Sponsor. articles.title: 65 Vietnamese Leaders and Enterprises Honored at Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards 2026 for Forging Legacies of Excellence
articles.summary: HO CHI MINH CITY, Vietnam, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 65 distinguished leaders and enterprises were honored for their outstanding achievements, entrepreneurial spirit, and enduring contributions at the Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards (APEA) 2026 Vietnam, held at GEM Center, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Organized by Enterprise Asia, the prestigious awards recognized entrepreneurs and organizations that have demonstrated excellence in leadership, business performance, innovation, and responsible growth, while making meaningful contributions to Vietnam's evolving business landscape. 65 Vietnamese Leaders and Enterprises Honored at Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards 2026 for Forging Legacies of Excellence Held under the theme "Forging Legacy: Celebrating Excellence, Inspiring Tomorrow", the Awards celebrated the achievements of leaders and enterprises that are building beyond the present to create lasting value for the future. This year's honorees demonstrated the vision, resilience, and adaptability needed to navigate a rapidly changing business environment, while remaining committed to innovation, responsible business practices, and long-term growth. More than 350 nominations from across Vietnam underwent a rigorous judging process conducted by a distinguished panel of experts. Nominees were evaluated based on leadership excellence, business performance, innovation, sustainability, governance, and overall impact. Following extensive deliberations, outstanding winners were selected across five award categories: Master Entrepreneur, Inspirational Brand, Fast Enterprise, Corporate Excellence, and the Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award. The newly introduced Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award recognizes organizations that demonstrate exemplary governance, ethical leadership, transparency, accountability, and effective risk management. Since 2007, the APEA has been organized across Asia to recognize exceptional business leaders and enterprises that have made significant contributions to entrepreneurship and economic development. Over the years, the Awards have recognized prominent business figures including Mr. Kwek Leng Beng of Hong Leong Group Singapore, Indonesia's Hary Tanoesoedibjo of MNC Group, the Philippines' Manuel Villar of Vista Land, and Vietnam's Dang Van Thanh of TTC Group. In his welcome address, Enterprise Asia Chairman Dr. Fong Chan Onn highlighted the importance of forward-looking leadership in driving sustainable growth and lasting impact. "Today's business landscape is evolving at an unprecedented pace. Enterprises must look beyond responding to change, harness innovation, strengthen collaboration, and embrace new opportunities. By leading with purpose and vision, businesses can achieve sustainable growth while creating lasting value for their stakeholders and communities." The distinguished awardees of the APEA 2026 Vietnam reflect the diversity, ambition, and entrepreneurial strength of Vietnam's business community. The Master Entrepreneur category recognized visionary leaders such as Mr. Ly Anh Duy Quang, BOD Member of GREENFEED Vietnam Corporation; Mr. Mai The Toan, Chairman of The Board of Directors of Petrovietnam Drilling & Well Service Corporation (PV Drilling), for their visionary leadership, entrepreneurial excellence, and ability to build businesses with lasting value. Under the Inspirational Brand category, industry leaders such as BaoViet Life Corporation, Bia Saigon, and 333 were honored for their strong brand presence, market influence, and meaningful engagement with customers and stakeholders. Fast-growing enterprises including Saigon International General Hospital (SIG) received the Fast Enterprise award for their impressive growth, agility, and ability to respond effectively to emerging opportunities. Meanwhile, established organizations such as Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB BANK) and Masterise Group were recognized under the Corporate Excellence category for their sustained business performance, organizational strength, and contributions to their respective industries. The Corporate Integrity and Governance Excellence Award further recognized organizations including Saigon Bank For Industry And Trade (SAIGONBANK) and Kafi Securities Corporation for their commitment to ethical leadership, sound governance, transparency, and responsible corporate practices. The APEA 2026 Vietnam Chapter is supported by Snowball Consulting as its Official Implementation Partner, with PR Newswire serving as the Official News Release Distribution Partner and COCOON as the Door Gift Sponsor.
